Jordan / Elena / Procurement team,

Appreciate the context and the usage file — helpful. We can absolutely put together a short formal proposal. High-level options based on what you described: 

Option A (90-day price hold + short-term ramp credits)
- Maintain current committed per-token rate for 90 days from signature
- Add 150k tokens/month committed for 3 months with a 20% ramp credit applied to overage billing for months 1-3 (reduces effective unit cost during ramp)
- Standard SLA and support; no change to billing cadence

Option B (multi-month committed uplift)
- Convert the 150k/month into a 12-month add-on commit at a slightly reduced rate (5% - 12% depending on final volume mix)
- One-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice equal to 25% of first-month committed charges

We recommend Option A if procurement needs a short-term bridge, and Option B if you want predictable unit economics longer term.

Next steps: if you prefer Option A we can generate a short amendment + credit schedule for signature (DocuSign). If procurement needs more detail on pricing bands, I can loop in Marissa with the proposed amortization schedule.

I'll follow up internally with David and Marissa to confirm capacity availability and margin impact and send a consolidated draft by Friday. Can we tentatively schedule a 30-minute sync Thu 10am PT?

Best,

- 20% ramp credit applied to overage billing for months 1-3 (applies to charges above existing committed allowance)
